name: certifi-bundle
command:
import certifi,ssl,json
assert certifi.__version__ == "2026.10.19"
context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
names={value for cert in context.get_ca_certs() for rdn in cert["subject"] for key,value in rdn if key=="commonName"}
assert "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" not in names
assert context.cert_store_stats()["x509_ca"]>0
print(json.dumps({"version":certifi.__version__,"removedRoot":"emSign ECC Root CA - G3","removedRootPresent":False,"certificateStore":context.cert_store_stats(),"networkProbe":False}))
